review_scope: Static source and metadata review only. The helper was not imported or executed; its fixtures were not rerun. No B, systemd, score result, prediction, target, model, checkpoint, cache, or array payload was accessed.

reviewed_files.role: Reviewed standard-library result and receipt validator; no filesystem reads or scorer imports in build_root_acceptance.
Focused synthetic metadata fixture; prior actor-reported 7 tests passed, not rerun by this review.
Final local check record; exact final pin confirmed from filesystem.
Bounded reader whose raw capture is the producer contract for capture_raw.

validated_contract: Strict UTF-8 JSON parsing rejects duplicate object keys and NaN/Infinity; bool is not accepted as a numeric score or strict integer.
The captured status unit must match the exact score unit and invocation and have active/exited with MainPID=0, ExecMainCode=1, ExecMainStatus=0, Result=success.
Exact bounded base64, byte-count, and SHA-256 joins are enforced for the captured result, ADMISSION.json, LAUNCH.json, unit.log tail, fixed export acceptance/stop, binding, and manifest.
The score admission and launch records join the exact export unit/invocation, result path, accepted export receipts, scorer-code pins, submission outcome, and score invocation.

The fixed five-arm model/checkpoint/receipt identities, 468-group export membership, source/split pins, registered-source observations, score schema, metric/mask, four paired contrasts, bootstrap count/seed, finite numeric ranges, and exposure limitations are checked.

The returned compact ROOT receipt preserves the original RESULT byte count and digest and makes no fit-gain or public-transfer claim. Its exclusive writer uses O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW and fsyncs the new file and parent directory.
capture_provenance_limit: The helper checks the reviewed V4 capture schema, exact score unit/invocation, strict native success tuple, bounded file joins, log tail, and scorer code pins. It requires parent, cgroup, and selected-GPU fields to exist at top level but does not semantically revalidate their contents. Callers must supply the direct raw stdout from the separately reviewed V4 bounded reader/driver; this helper alone does not establish those resource observations.
